page.overview:
What is Mamebatta?

Nymble evolves into Lokix starting at level 24.

Nymble appears to be based on a . The fact that it cannot fly, unlike most grasshoppers, may suggest it is based on a meadow grasshopper, or a grasshopper in its nymph stage, which is alluded to in its English name. It may also be based on due to its coloration and rounded features. The way its third set of legs fold up resembles .

Nymble may be based off the words "nymph" and "nimble", which means quick and fast.
